noise_benchmark.note: How often each shape appears on real prices versus on random walks matched to the same volatility. A ratio near 1 means the shape is what randomness produces anyway. This is NOT an edge measurement - it is the prior question of whether the shape is a property of the market at all.

figures_note: recognition_confidence describes how cleanly a shape matches its definition - never a probability of any price outcome; read edge_state for that. `resolution` says whether this one figure reached its trigger or its invalidation first: an observation about that instance, not an edge.
